title: Patch: a generated card index (by keyword, tag and pool) replaces the spec's hand-kept card lists
notes: Issue #3804 (and #3795): spec/CARDS.md lists every card by keyword, tag and named pool, written by `cargo jackioh spec index` from the catalog and crates/cards/src/query.rs's POOLS, and the spec's hand-kept lists state their rule and link it. Eleven scripts (C+ #48, C+ #52, M+ #4, S #130, S #81 to #83, #85, #86, M #31 and M #55) draw from the named pools instead of writing the query inline; each query is the same, so their draws are unchanged, but their code is new, and Meditative+ #25 KY's Intuition offers a card as its code block (R1183004), so its offers of those eleven show the new code.

player.title: KY's Intuition shows current code
changes: KY's Intuition's blocks of card code show the current code of eleven cards that add or Discover from a random pool, such as Jlockeed's Lobbyist and Radix.
